args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

The docstring (and FIN-212) require banker's rounding, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, contradicting both its own docstring and FIN-212, which mandate banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN). This caused the nightly test failure in `tests/test_money.py` (`2.665` was rounding up to `2.67` instead of down to `2.66`).

## Change
- Switch the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` passed.
args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix banker's rounding per FIN-212 (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
